dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: Nara friend knows Aranara's mind and Aradanish's as well. Nara friend sure can find the one Aradanish wants among many other things.

dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: This time, Aradanish wants... <color=#00E1FFFF>A small wooden chest</color>! Nara friend will find for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: No, no, Aradanish doesn't want that. Nara needs to think again.

dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: Aradanish will always be here. Come back anytime Nara wants to play a game.

dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: Golden Nara is as fast as they said!

dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: Only good Nara plays games with Aradanish. This is for Nara friend!

dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: Nara friend is here. Come to play games with Aradanish?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't have the time right now.

dialogues.speaker: Aradanish
dialogues.text: Aradanish will wait, until Nara does.
